# Get information about an International Credit Transfer

Query an incoming [International Credit Transfer](/payments/concepts/credit-transfers/international/incoming#incoming-booked) by its transaction ID.

## Guide {#guide}

1. Call the `transaction` query.
1. Add the transaction ID for the incoming International Credit Transfer.
1. Add the information you want to review.

## Query {#query}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2} showLineNumbers
query IncomingInternationalCreditTransfer {
  transaction(id: "$INCOMING_TRANSACTION_ID") {
    ... on InternationalCreditTransferTransaction {
      amount { #amount credited to the Swan user's account
        currency
        value
      }
      counterparty #name of the counterparty
      currencyExchange { 
        exchangeRate
      }
      debtor {
        ... on InternationalCreditTransferInDebtor {
          name
          accountNumber
          bic
        }
        ... on InternationalCreditTransferOutDebtor {
          name
        }
      }
      instructedAmount { #amount the debtor sent in their original currency when initiating the transfer
        currency
        value
      }
      intermediaryBankFees { #list of all fees charged by intermediary banks (doesn't include Swan)
        currency
        value
      }
      side
    }
  }
}
```

## Payload {#payload}

For an incoming transfer, `accountNumber` holds the debtor's IBAN or local account number as the sending bank provided it.

```json {6,10,13-15,18,22,26,30} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "transaction": {
      "amount": {
        "currency": "EUR",
        "value": "850.00"
      },
      "counterparty": "Debtor",
      "currencyExchange": {
        "exchangeRate": "1.05263"
      },
      "debtor": {
        "name": "My debtor",
        "accountNumber": "GB12345678901234567890",
        "bic": "BUKBGB22"
      },
      "instructedAmount": {
        "currency": "GBP",
        "value": "1000.00"
      },
      "intermediaryBankFees": [
        {
          "value": "50.00",
          "currency": "GBP"
        },
        {
          "value": "100.00",
          "currency": "EUR"
        },
        {
          "value": "50.00",
          "currency": "EUR"
        }
      ],
      "side": "credit"
    }
  }
}
```
